items.title: Add mapped YAML record review ledger
items.body:
## Summary

- Add `reports/yaml_record_review/manifest.tsv` covering all 2679 mapped ingredient YAML records
- Add one Markdown review report per mapped record under `reports/yaml_record_review/`
- Keep the review artifacts separate from curated YAML data; no curated records are changed

## Validation

- Manifest structurally validates and covers the exact `data/ingredients/mapped/*.yaml` set
- 2679 manifest rows and 2679 Markdown reports are present
- Report text is ASCII except exact Greek-alpha path headers/manifest paths
- `git diff --cached --check` passed before commit
- `uv run --frozen python scripts/validate_sssom_invariants.py` passed Rules A, B1, B2, B3, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K with only the expected local Rule B4 skip
- `uv run --frozen python scripts/validate_component_partonomy.py` passed with 0 violations

items.title: Triage the CultureMech unresolved residual, and land its alias head
items.body:
## What this is

CultureMech has 6,105 ingredient mentions (1,911 distinct labels) that MIM cannot
resolve. Read raw, that looks like ~1,900 compounds needing research. It isn't, and the
first commit is the triage that shows why: CultureMech resolves against MIM's **literal**
label index, so a surface form differing only by a vendor tag, a concentration, or a
middot codepoint fails even where MIM already holds the compound.

| bucket | labels | mentions | meaning |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| ALIAS | 274 | 935 | folds onto a MAPPED record -- spelling only |
| UNMAPPED | 210 | 1,116 | folds onto a record that exists but is ungrounded |
| AMBIGUOUS | 55 | 383 | two or more records publish the label (#504) |
| NOISE | 24 | 618 | CultureMech parse damage (CultureMech#387) |
| RESIDUAL | 1,348 | 3,053 | genuinely absent -- the real grounding work |

42% of the unresolved mass needed no grounding at all.

## What it lands

- **276 surface forms added as synonyms** on the 156 records that already denote them.
  Asserts no new chemical identity.
- **4 records promoted to MICRO** on exact synonym matches: `BG-11 Medium` ->
  MICRO:0001348, `Bordet-Gengou-Agar-Base` -> MICRO:0002398, `Casman-Agar-Base` ->
  MICRO:0002402, `Ox-bile` -> MICRO:0000610.
- **Measured effect: 287 more labels (940 recipe mentions) resolve literally.** Index
  8,367 -> 9,394 rows, all new rows `unique`, conflict count unchanged at 468, nothing
  removed.

Four tools, all dry-run or read-only by default: `triage_culturemech_residual.py`,
`apply_culturemech_aliases.py`, `propose_residual_groundings.py`,
`create_records_from_groundings.py`.

It also unblocks MICRO in `promote_resolved_unmapped.py`. MICRO models named growth
media, MIM publishes 48 MICRO records, and OBJECT_SOURCE has carried `obo:micro.owl`
since #381 -- but the guard was keyed on ONTOLOGY_DB and MICRO's local build is a 0-byte
stub, so every MICRO promotion was refused. `canonical_label` now falls back to OLS4,
looking a term up by `obo_id` rather than a constructed IRI (MICRO:0002398's IRI is
`.../obo/MicrO.owl/MICRO_0002398`, so the constructed form 404s on exactly the terms this
unblocks), rejecting obsolete terms and IRI-fragment labels.

## The part worth reviewing closely

**Five defects, every one found by auditing output rather than reading code.** Each would
have shipped a wrong identity or an unreviewable diff.

1. **The fold discarded chemistry.** Under `re.IGNORECASE` the vendor-tag branch matched
   *any* parenthetical: `AlK(SO4)2 (anhydrous)` folded to `alk 2`, `EDTA(Disodium salt)`
   to `edta`. And hydration state is identity -- CaCl2 and CaCl2 x 2 H2O are 110.98 and
   147.01 g/mol (MAPPING_SEMANTICS Section 3) -- so folding `(anhydrous)` away lets an
   anhydrous form inherit a hydrate's identifier. **A wrong mapping where the status quo
   was merely a missing one.** Fixing it moved 70 labels out of ALIAS.
2. **NCIT captured everything.** 2.7 GB of clinical and gene concepts whose *alias* space
   collides with ingredient names: `B12` -> `TNFAIP1 wt Allele`, `Absolute ethanol` ->
   `Alcohol`, plus `Potato`/`Skim milk` that belong in FOODON. NCIT and MESH are now
   label-only and last in preference order.
3. **Every OLS4 synonym match was silently discarded**, because a server-side exact match
   was re-checked client-side against the label alone. `Christensen's urea agar` -- an
   exact MICRO synonym of `urea agar` -- was thrown away. The MICRO pass was label-only
   without reporting it.
4. **Ontology preference was decided by capitalisation.** oaklib's `basic_search` is
   case-sensitive, so with query variants as the outer loop the raw `Air` reached NCIT
   before the normalised `air` reached ENVO: the same substance grounded to NCIT:C73434
   and ENVO:00002005.
5. **`width=100` on the YAML dump** reflowed every long string, burying 2 added lines
   under 33 spurious ones. The corpus canonical format is PyYAML's default wrap
   (verified: 60/60 sampled records round-trip byte-identically without it).
6. **An exact match does not mean the term is a substance.** `Dissolve` matched
   NCIT:C64929 (a procedure) and `Stock A` matched NCIT:C14643 -- perfect label matches,
   neither an ingredient. This is the #356 class, where `X` was published as EXACT_MATCH
   against the 24th letter of the alphabet on a record with 101 occurrences, and no
   amount of ontology routing fixes it because the string really does match. Terms from
   broad ontologies must now descend from NCIT:C1908.
7. **I routed around a guard without recognising it as one.** The OLS4 fallback looks
   terms up by `obo_id` *because* MicrO's IRI is malformed -- which is exactly the
   condition `MICRO_VERIFIED` gates on. CI caught it: two promotions were demoted, and
   the fallback now refuses `is_defining_ontology=false` itself (requesting `fieldList`
   explicitly, since OLS4 omits the field unless asked and the check would read None and
   silently pass).

Guards, each added after it caught something real: `REJECTED_LABEL` never promoted
(#477); an identifier held by >1 record skipped (ownership is a merge decision); a
spelling two records would claim dropped (an ambiguous index row is worse than a miss --
CultureMech fails closed on it); case variants collapsed; names under 3 characters never
matched (`X` hit UBERON's "area X of ventral lateral nucleus").

No `occurrence_count` on synonyms: none of the corpus's ~7k carries one, and MIM's counts
are over MIM's ingest while these are over CultureMech's -- mixing them double-counts,
per the rule set in `add_culturemech_gap_labels.py`.

## What it deliberately does not do

- **Does not resolve the 55 ambiguous labels** (#504). Three defects are mixed there, and
  one is an identity error published *now*: `CoCl2 6H2O` matches records for the di- and
  tetra-hydrate.
- **Does not mint.** MICRO has no term for the commercial broths (`PPLO broth`,
  `Trypticase soy broth`, `GAM broth` all return nothing), so Section 3 step 3 would mint
  -- but that is ~100 new published identifiers and belongs in its own reviewed change.
- **Does not touch the 91 UNDEFINED_MIXTURE records**, for which staying UNMAPPED is the
  correct outcome.

## Verification

- `validate-strict`: 0 errors over 2,853 files
- SSSOM Rules A/B1/B2/B3/C/D/E pass; `reconcile_sssom` GAP/ORPHAN/STALE all 0
- `validate-products`: "all id-label pairs correspond"
- 57 tests; the four fold guards were checked to fail against the pre-fix code

## Filed from this work

- #503 `strip_hydrate_notation` truncates every spelled-out hydrate to a meaningless stem
- #504 25 identifier sets publish one label from two or more records
- CultureMech#387 618 mentions carry parse damage; all 497 numeric ones are recoverable
